The decision sheet is the product, so these reports matter more than most.

## Which decision

The group and the row, or the plan field if you know it.

## Which of these is it

- [ ] The decision is missing from the sheet, but the plan contains it
- [ ] The decision has no reason, or the reason does not explain the choice
- [ ] Changing it re-runs more than it should
- [ ] Changing it re-runs less than it should, and the output is wrong
- [ ] The stated cost did not match what happened
- [ ] The control is the wrong control for this decision
